title: AI assists a proof of a uniform gap for the square-lattice AKLT model
summary: The preprint reports a uniform lower bound for the spectral gap on sufficiently large square-lattice tori and uniqueness results for the ground state.
ai_technology: Claude Opus 5.5; Fable 5.2; Luna 6; GPT-6.1 Sol; GPT-6 Astra

evidence.tested: The authors report computer-assisted verification and Lean work.
evidence.unknown: The exact correspondence and coverage of a kernel-checked theorem and independent confirmation were not established in this review.
evidence.ai_role: The authors attribute proof discovery and verification work to a combination of language models.
